record_title: A sharp row-coherence obstruction in PDNQP diagonal step initialization
provenance: Mathematical analysis of the diagonal primal-dual mass initialization in arXiv:2609.19557, including a sharp full-row-rank residual-form family, an explicit acceptance-failure direction, and a comparison with coupling-safe row-l1 scaling.
limitations: The construction is a structured worst-case family and does not assert typical benchmark behavior. The result concerns the initial diagonal scaling and a rejected trial direction, not divergence or an end-to-end complexity lower bound. The row-l1 comparison controls the coupling operator only and is not claimed to replace the full PDNQP acceptance mechanism. The motivating preprint is recent and later revisions may alter the relevant formulas or discussion.
